title: 第21章 在一声声哥哥中迷失自我
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 辰楠看着妹妹们满脸的幸福之色，一时间有些难受。很难想象这是一颗糖做到的，这是没过过好日子才会如此。又或者说小孩子的幸福就是如此简单。他轻轻放下怀里的幺妹，转身又从那个看似普通的麻包袋里掏起来。“爷，奶，这是给你们的。“辰楠先拿出两套崭新的衣裳和布鞋，递给爷爷奶奶。爷爷接过那套深蓝色的中山装，手指微微发颤；奶奶拿着藏青色的上衣和裤子，连连摆手：“这、这太浪费了！我们老两口有衣服穿，快拿去退了吧！“辰楠早就料到二老会推辞，笑着说：“百货大楼的东西跟供销社不一样，买了就没那么容易退啦。“这话半真半假，却让二老信以为真。爷爷摩挲着崭新的布料，奶奶翻来覆去地看着手中的衣裳，脸上的皱纹都笑开了花。他们已经记不清上次穿新衣服是什么时候了。这一幕看得妹妹们很是羡慕，她们也好久没穿新衣服了。但羡慕也没用，新衣服肯定没她们的份呀。辰楠把这一切都看在眼里，接下来他的做法让妹妹们激动不已。他像变戏法似的，从麻包袋里一件接一件地往外拿。九套颜色各异的小衣裳，九双崭新的布鞋，还有九个用透明纸包着的漂亮发卡。“招娣（大妹），来娣（二妹），盼娣（三妹）幺妹胜娣...“辰楠按照从大到小的顺序，一一叫着妹妹们的名字，把属于她们的那份递到手中。“啊，哥哥，这……”妹妹们简直不敢相信自已的眼睛。这是真的吗？招娣捧着一套浅色的上衣和深蓝色的裤子，手指轻轻抚过上面细密的针脚。来娣得到了一双期盼已久的青色布鞋，激动得小脸通红。最小的幺妹抱着属于自已的鹅黄色小衣裳，把脸埋在上面蹭啊蹭，感受着新布料柔软的触感。“这发卡...“十二岁的招娣拿起一个红色的蝴蝶发卡，声音有些哽咽，“真好看。““我来帮你戴上。“辰楠接过发卡，小心地别在招娣的辫子上。红色的蝴蝶在她乌黑的头发上振翅欲飞，衬得她消瘦的小脸都有了光彩。“真好看。”招娣被这句话弄得小脸发烫。其他妹妹们也迫不及待地互相帮着戴发卡，一时间，院子里飞舞着五颜六色的蝴蝶、小鸟和小花。奶奶看着这一幕，既欣慰又心疼：“小楠啊，这得花多少钱啊！”“奶奶，以后我们会更好的。“辰楠爽朗一笑。爷爷在一旁摇摇头并没有说话，小楠今年才十八岁，还要明年才能正式上班，上哪儿赚钱去？辰楠但笑不语，解释再也多没啥用。就在这时，幺妹天真灿烂地说：“新衣服，留着过年穿。”这话像一根针，轻轻扎在辰楠的心上。他蹲下身，平视着妹妹们：“不，今天洗完澡就穿新衣服、新鞋子。”“哥哥还带了布料回来，够你们每人再做两套新衣裳呢！“说着，他从麻包袋里取出那匹浅蓝色的布料，整整六十尺，在夕阳下泛着柔和的光泽。“哇！”妹妹们齐声惊呼，眼睛瞪得圆溜溜的。奶奶倒吸一口凉气：“小楠啊，你哪来这么多布料？就算有钱，没布票也买不到啊！”“奶奶，有些事我不好解释，但我保证肯定不犯法，您就放心吧。”辰楠神秘地眨眨眼，“以后咱们家的日子，会越来越好的。“正当妹妹们围着布料叽叽喳喳讨论要做什么样式的衣裳时，二妹来娣突然指着院子角落惊呼：“姐姐，你看那是什么？黑乎乎的一大团！”招娣顺着她指的方向看去，顿时倒吸一口凉气：“是野猪！好大的野猪！“其他妹妹们也发现了那个庞然大物，一时间惊叫声此起彼伏。奶奶在一旁笑得合不拢嘴：“那是你们哥哥捡回来的，亏你们现在才看见！”老人家心里平衡了不少——总算不是只有她跟老头子被吓到了。“哥哥好厉害！”“哥哥真棒棒！”“哥哥好样的！”“好多肉肉啊！”妹妹们看向辰楠的目光里满是崇拜的小星星。一声声稚嫩的赞美让辰楠的嘴角忍不住上扬。他试图保持严肃，但那嘴角翘起的弧度比AK还难压，最终还是露出了一个灿烂的笑容。辰楠也在这一声声哥哥中迷失自我。这一刻，他真切地感受到了作为九个妹妹的哥哥是多么幸福的一件事。灵魂与肉身之间那丝若有若无的排斥感，在这一刻烟消云散。他只觉浑身舒坦，每一个毛孔都透着畅快。“哥哥今天高兴，“辰楠环视着妹妹们期待的小脸，朗声宣布：“那咱们今天就吃杀猪宴，你们说好不好？”“好耶！好耶！“妹妹们顿时欢呼雀跃，甜甜的笑声在小院内回荡。辰楠看着这一幕，心里涌起一股暖流。无论前路多么艰难，他都要让这些可爱的妹妹们过上好日子。这才是他想要守护的——家人的笑容，温馨的团聚，以及充满希望的明天。“这野猪那么大，我们难以处理。”“你们说该怎么办好？”辰楠看向妹妹们，她们都是女孩，血腥的事情他可不希望她们看到。“哥哥，我们可以帮忙呀，帮忙可以快点吃肉肉。”幺妹胜娣哈喇子都快流出来了，可见她是多渴望能吃到肉。其他妹妹也差不多是这个想法，她们可以一起帮忙，这样哥哥就不需要一个人太累。“哥哥，要不……喊大伯来帮忙？”大妹招娣试探性地开口，若是有大伯的帮忙，哥哥肯定能很轻松。辰楠竖起一根大拇指，看着大妹笑道：“没错，我就是想说喊大伯过来帮忙。”“总不能我们自已处理好了野猪再去喊大伯一家过来吃，肯定要让大伯来帮忙才有得吃。”在乡下大伯帮了她们许多，如今有好东西肯定不能忘了大伯。若是这个大伯对他们不好，辰楠是一根猪毛都不想给他的。妹妹们觉得有人来帮忙干活是一件好事，至于能多吃少吃这点倒是没什么概念。如今哥哥对她们那么好，她们当然也不能让哥哥一个人处理野猪累着呀。
content_en: Chen Nan felt a little uncomfortable for a moment when she saw the happy expressions on her sisters' faces.It’s hard to imagine that this is what a piece of candy can do. This is what happens if you haven’t lived a good life.Or maybe a child's happiness is so simple.He gently put down Yaomei in his arms, turned around and picked it up again from the seemingly ordinary sack."Master, grandma, this is for you." Chen Nan first took out two sets of brand new clothes and cloth shoes and handed them to his grandparents.Grandpa took the dark blue tunic suit, his fingers trembling slightly; Grandma took the navy blue top and trousers and waved her hands: "This, this is such a waste! We, the old couple, have clothes to wear, so hurry up and return it!" Chen Nan had already expected that the two elders would refuse, and said with a smile: "The things in department stores are different from those in supply and marketing cooperatives, and it is not so easy to return them after buying them." This was half true and half false, but the two elders believed it to be true.Grandpa was stroking the brand new fabric, and grandma was looking at the clothes in her hands over and over again, all the wrinkles on her face were smiling.They can't remember the last time they wore new clothes.This scene made the sisters very envious, as they had not worn new clothes for a long time.But there is no point in being envious, the new clothes are definitely not worth it to them.Chen Nan saw all this, and what he did next made the sisters excited.Like magic, he took out one piece after another from the sack.Nine sets of small clothes of different colors, nine pairs of brand new cloth shoes, and nine beautiful hairpins wrapped in transparent paper."Zhaodi (eldest sister), Laidi (second sister), Pandi (third sister), the younger sister Shengdi..." Chen Nan called the names of the sisters one by one in order from oldest to youngest, and handed their portions to their hands."Ah, brother, this..." The sisters couldn't believe their eyes.Is this true?Zhaodi held up a set of light-colored tops and dark blue trousers, and gently touched the fine stitches on them with her fingers.Laidi got a pair of long-awaited blue cloth shoes, and her face turned red with excitement.The youngest Yaomei held her own little goose-yellow dress, burying her face in it and rubbing it, feeling the soft touch of the new fabric."This hairpin..." Twelve-year-old Zhaodi picked up a red butterfly hairpin, her voice choked up, "It's so beautiful." "I'll help you put it on." Chen Nan took the hairpin and carefully pinned it on Zhaodi's braid.Red butterflies were fluttering on her black hair, making her thin face look radiant."It's so beautiful." Zhaodi's face became hot at these words.The other sisters couldn't wait to help each other put on hairpins. For a while, colorful butterflies, birds and flowers were flying in the yard.Grandma looked at this scene, feeling both relieved and distressed: "Xiao Nan, how much does this cost?" "Grandma, we will be better in the future." Chen Nan smiled heartily.Grandpa shook his head and said nothing. Xiaonan is only eighteen years old this year and will not be able to officially go to work until next year. Where can he make money?Chen Nan just smiled and said nothing, no more explanations would be of any use.At this moment, Yaomei said innocently and brilliantly: "I'll save the new clothes for the New Year." These words were like a needle, gently piercing Chen Nan's heart.He knelt down and looked at his sisters: "No, I will wear new clothes and new shoes after taking a shower today." "Brother also brought back fabric, enough for each of you to make two new sets of clothes!" As he said that, he took out the light blue fabric from the sack, which was six feet long and glowed softly in the sunset."Wow!" the sisters exclaimed in unison, their eyes widened.Grandma took a breath: "Xiao Nan, where did you get so much fabric? Even if you have money, you can't buy it without a cloth ticket!" "Grandma, there are some things I can't explain, but I promise it won't be illegal. Don't worry." Chen Nan blinked mysteriously, "Our family's life will get better and better in the future." Just as the sisters were chattering around the fabrics.While discussing what style of clothes to wear, the second sister Laidi suddenly pointed to the corner of the yard and exclaimed: "Sister, what do you see that is? A big black mass!" Zhaodi looked in the direction she pointed and suddenly took a breath: "It's a wild boar! What a big wild boar!" The other sisters also discovered the huge thing, and screams came one after another.Grandma was smiling from ear to ear: "Your brother picked it up, but you only saw it now!" The old man felt a lot more balanced - finally she and the old man were not the only ones who were frightened."Brother is so awesome!" "Brother is awesome!" "Brother is great!" "So much meat!" The younger sisters looked at Chen Nan with eyes full of adoration.The childish compliments made Chen Nan's lips couldn't help but turn up.He tried to remain serious, but the curve of the corner of his mouth was harder to suppress than AK, and he finally showed a bright smile.Chen Nan also lost herself in the shouts of brother.At this moment, he truly felt how happy it was to be the brother of nine sisters.The vague feeling of rejection between the soul and the body disappeared at this moment.He just felt comfortable all over, and every pore was filled with joy."Brother is happy today," Chen Nan looked around at the expectant little faces of the sisters and announced loudly, "Then let's have a pig-killing feast today, do you agree?" "Okay! Okay!" The sisters immediately cheered, and their sweet laughter echoed in the small courtyard.Chen Nan looked at this scene and felt a warm current in his heart.No matter how difficult the road ahead is, he will let these lovely sisters live a good life.This is what he wants to protect - the smiles of his family, the warm reunion, and a hopeful tomorrow."This wild boar is so big, it's difficult for us to handle it." "What do you think we should do?" Chen Nan looked at his sisters. They were all girls. He didn't want them to see bloody things."Brother, we can help. If we help, we can eat meat faster." Yaomei Shengdi almost cried out, which shows how much she longs for meat.The other sisters have the same idea. They can help together so that the brother doesn't have to be too tired alone."Brother, why don't you... call your uncle to help?" Zhaodi, the eldest sister, said tentatively. If he had the help of his uncle, it would be easy for him.Chen Nan gave a thumbs up, looked at her eldest sister and said with a smile: "Yes, I just want to ask the uncle to come over and help." "We can't call the uncle's family over to eat after we have taken care of the wild boar ourselves. We must have the uncle come to help us to eat." In the countryside, the uncle helped them a lot, and now that there are good things, they must not forget the uncle.If this uncle treats them badly, Chen Nan won't give him a pig's hair.The sisters think it is a good thing to have someone to help with the work, but they have no idea about being able to eat more and less.Now that their brother is so kind to them, of course they can't let him deal with the wild boar alone.
